comparison.mrr: reciprocal rank of the first expected source, averaged per cohort
comparison.ndcg_at_k: binary relevance nDCG over every expected source at frozen top_k
comparison.recall_at_k: fraction of expected sources present at frozen top_k
comparison.forbidden_hit: any forbidden source present at frozen top_k
comparison.protected_safe_retained: every protected-safe source remains present at frozen top_k
comparison.relation_path_completeness: fraction of expected relation targets reached with a graph path
comparison.non_regression: NGR must be greater than or equal to github-rag-mcp on each frozen metric

strict_improvement_policy: not required; ceiling cases pass only by metric equality or improvement under the non-regression gates
